quote: Whenever any person is riding a bicycle, electric bicycle, or electric scooter upon a sidewalk, such person shall yield the right-of-way to any pedestrian and shall give audible signal before overtaking and passing such pedestrian.

activation.condition: A person rides a bicycle, electric bicycle, or electric scooter upon a sidewalk and overtakes and passes a pedestrian.

obligation.description: Yield the right-of-way to the pedestrian and give audible signal before overtaking and passing.

timing.description: Observe signal relative to actual original passing and yielding behavior through the approach.

judgment_calls_needed.phrase: yield the right-of-way to any pedestrian
judgment_calls_needed.note: Original trajectories, full body separation and pedestrian response need independent review.
Original rider emitter event and pedestrian microphone waveform need independent physical and human audibility review.

parameter_refs.name: signal_timing
parameter_refs.range_or_domain: before pass, after pass, or silent
